_comment: sim-place-descent-reach-cage-v1 (coldwin91): give the collect place DESCENT a path that reaches the CORRECTED cart seat (carton bottom 0.9325 world, PR 375's settled shelf flat top) WITHOUT the gripper side-grip HOUSING catching on the Rollwagen cage. THE JAM (scripts/check_place_descent_reach.py over the cw87 run artifacts): coldwin87's place-descent plan (host-stack TRAJ_HOST_PLAN, 13 leveled waypoints) starts from the standoff at the CARRY wrist orientation (wrist_2 ~ 0.28) and its first leg reorients to the place PAD-DOWN orientation (wrist_2 ~ 1.63) WHILE the gripper housing sits inside the +x cage mouth, so the UNFILTERED housing link cube_without_surface_plates wedges against the upper side bar side_1_horizontal_6 (and the mouth posts post_2/post_3) at the descent START -- the ONLY penetrating config of the whole path (CPU -1.9 mm at cw87, -13.8 mm cw64, -33.8 mm cw88, -36.4 mm cw89; every other waypoint >= +0.10 m). wrist_2 then froze at 0.28 against the 1.63 rad command -> TRAJ_HOST_TRACK_MISS worst_j=4 err 1.30 -> PATH_TOLERANCE_VIOLATED. It is NOT a reach/joint limit: the 1.63 rad target and the whole reoriented chain are far inside limits and >= +0.10 m clear; only the standoff carry-wrist orientation penetrates. THE FIX: hold the PAD-DOWN wrist branch (wrist_2 ~ 1.63) from the standoff to the seat so the housing never reorients in-cage -- CPU-proven >= +0.10 m clear at every collect-place park pose, tilt 1.72 deg (<= the UNTOUCHED 2.0 deg bound), landing exactly at the corrected seat. ALL keys/hooks absent => byte-identical (default off).
_host_block: Merge into the mission HOST config block (restock_manipulation/ros_host_config.json, read by scripts/twin/restock_manipulation/ros_host.py -> TransferController). These are the PR 366/379 carry-connected standoff selector keys the fix extends; they must already be ON for the live_pose collect place-on-cart capstone.
_preplace_descent_feasible_note: HOST bool (config_preflight knows it). With the place-descent cage gate injected (see _descent_cage_gate below), the carry-connected standoff selector's descent-feasibility predictor (controller._preplace_descent_predictor) now also treats a cage-RAKING descent as infeasible -- not just one over the 2.0 deg tilt bound -- so the selector DISCARDS the carry-wrist branch (whose descent wedges the housing in the +x mouth) and advances to the PAD-DOWN wrist branch whose descent holds the housing clear. Without the gate injected this key keeps its PR 379 tilt-only behaviour (byte-identical). Requires preplace_branch_prefer_carry_connected.
_descent_cage_gate: OPT-IN refuse-by-name gate AND the selector's cage criterion (the primary sim-place-descent-reach-cage-v1 mechanism). The capability is place_clearance.place_descent_cage_clearance_provider(urdf_path, xrdf_path, cart_pose, margin=0.03) -> callable(waypoints)->reject|None, injected into the controller as controller._place_descent_cage_gate by the boot/integration layer (where the live coupled cart-body -> ur_base_link pose + the host XRDF are available), EXACTLY as controller._preplace_cage_clearance is injected for the PR 366 pre-place gate. When set it does TWO things: (a) the carry-connected standoff selector's descent predictor raises on a cage-raking candidate descent, so the standoff is chosen on the cage-CLEAR pad-down branch; and (b) the place-descent dispatch sweeps the planned leveled set-down waypoints and refuses an intersecting descent BY NAME before motion ('PLACE_DESCENT_CAGE_CLEARANCE prim=side_1_horizontal_6 min_clearance=-1.9mm ... cube_without_surface_plates ...'), instead of coldwin87's blind PATH_TOLERANCE wrist-2 jam. None (default) => inert => byte-identical. The gate checks the cuMotion ARM SPHERE model (world_obstacles.arm_spheres_world) -- the real robot-link collision set incl. the gripper housing -- against the CAGE bodies (posts + side/back bars; place_clearance.cage_body_names), at the 30 mm design margin (the clear descent reads +0.10 m, far outside the documented ~40-90 mm CPU-vs-sim calibration noise, so 30 mm is safe here unlike the pre-place sweep's penetration-only 0 mm).
_place_seat_gate_note: HOST bool (PR 375, sim-place-seat-geometry-v1). REQUIRED for the descent to target the CORRECTED seat (support top + carton half, carton-centre frame) rather than the +3.8 cm-too-high model support top. The cage-clear descent lands the carton bottom at 0.9325 world; the seat gate then releases the weld at true contact. Without it the descent would target the old too-high support and stop short of the seat.
_runtime_block: Merge into the mission RUNTIME config block (read by scripts/twin/restock/isaac_bundle.py -> RuntimeAdapter). These are the collect place-on-cart live_pose keys that must already be ON (unchanged by this lane).
_cage_collision_note: RUNTIME. The carton (handling unit) is PhysicsFilteredPairs-filtered vs the whole cage, so ONLY the gripper housing (a robot link) can contact the cage -- which is exactly what this lane's gate sweeps. UNCHANGED.
_requires: preplace_level_gate + preplace_reaction_branch + preplace_branch_prefer_carry_connected + preplace_descent_feasible must be ON (the descent-feasibility selector the cage criterion extends), the station-hold keys (station_pitch_hold / station_hold_pitch_deg / station_hold_roll_deg) ON (world-frame leveling), place_from_above ON (the L-path descent), and place_seat_gate ON (the corrected seat target, PR 375). The boot/integration layer must inject controller._place_descent_cage_gate from place_clearance.place_descent_cage_clearance_provider with the live coupled cart pose + host XRDF (as it already does for controller._preplace_cage_clearance). No new config-preflight key is introduced (the gate is a provider injection like the pre-place gate).
_cpu_proof: scripts/check_place_descent_reach.py (exit 0): the cw87 in-cage-reorient descent is REFUSED at every collect-place park pose (cw87/cw64/cw88/cw89), and the pad-down remedy descent to the corrected seat PASSES -- clear >= 0.03 m (actually +0.10 .. +0.14 m) at every park, tilt 1.72 deg (<= the untouched 2.0 bound), carton bottom lands at 0.9325 world (|err| 0.0 mm). Guarded CPU tests: scripts/twin/tests/test_place_descent_reach.py.
_bounded_gpu_proof: Re-run the coldwin87 live_pose collect place-on-cart capstone chain under /tmp/aile-gpu.lock (HEAVY_MB=2500 for the always-on whispr) with this HOST block merged and controller._place_descent_cage_gate injected -> coldwin91. Expected PASS: the console logs the selector choosing the pad-down wrist branch (PREPLACE_REACTION_BRANCH chosen wrist_2 ~ 1.63, descent-feasible), the place descent holds wrist_2 ~ 1.63 from the standoff (NO in-cage reorient, NO PLACE_DESCENT_CAGE_CLEARANCE refusal, NO TRAJ_HOST_TRACK_MISS worst_j=4 / PATH_TOLERANCE), the welded carton descends to the corrected seat (carton bottom ~0.9325 world), the PR 375 seat gate releases the weld at true contact, and the carton rests/verifies on the shelf. If instead the gate REFUSES the descent by name, read the named prim: a residual wedge means the standoff selector could not reach the pad-down branch (the approach-side feasibility is the pre-place lane's, PR 366 -- see data/sim-place-descent-reach-cage-v1/report.md 'Open question: approach feasibility of the pad-down standoff'); if the carton lands short of or past the seat, re-check place_seat_gate + the resolved support top. Do NOT loosen the 2.0 deg tilt bound or the 30 mm cage margin.
